mapper.select: SELECT recommendation_id AS recommendationId, condition_id AS conditionId, admin_dong_id AS adminDongId, total_score AS totalScore, data_coverage_rate AS dataCoverageRate, commute_time AS commuteTime, transfer_count AS transferCount, `rank`, recommendation_reason AS recommendationReason, caution FROM recommendations WHERE condition_id = #{conditionId} ORDER BY `rank` ASC
